# Cutout Tales (third-party origin)

The "Cutout tales" look (`worker/templates/cutout-tales/kit.js`) is a JavaScript Canvas 2D port of the character rig,
sets, camera and overlay kit from the MIT-licensed **growkaz-cutout-tales** skill (Python + pycairo), copyright (c) 2026
Grow With Kaz. See `LICENSE.txt` in this folder; the notice is also embedded in the built template.

What was ported: drawing helpers, character rig (poses, expressions, idle motion), sets and moods, parallax camera,
dust and vignette, overlays. What was not: the Python render loop, `align.py`, `sfx.py`. The archetype ids and example
names are original; no game, film or TV characters.
